title: TipsPaidRequest
description: tips.paid-request@1: bodies of the paid requests on OpenVibe.Tips: POST /api/v1/checkout (tips.checkout.create: a tip), POST /api/v1/paid-messages (tips.superchat.create: needs message; paid_message_min applies), POST /api/v1/tts-requests (tips.tts.request: needs text to read, tts.text or message, within the creator's TTS settings) and POST /api/v1/media-requests (tips.media_request.create: needs media.url; the creator's minimum and length apply): { creator, amount, supporter?, supporter_name?, message?, pay_with?, provider?, tts?, media?, goal_id?, target?, privacy? }. The route sets the kind. A service names the supporter; a person pays as themselves. pay_with credit (default) pays from the supporter's Billing credit at once; checkout starts a Billing checkout (from TIPS_MIN_CHECKOUT_BITS, 100 bits by default). Tips never prices money; Billing does. Needs an Idempotency-Key header (8-200 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -; 400 idempotency.key_required): a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer, the same key with another body is 422 idempotency.key_reused. Refusals are problem+json: 422 tips.invalid_input, tips.invalid_amount, tips.amount_too_small, tips.text_too_long (message over TIPS_MESSAGE_CHARS, 300 by default), tips.invalid_media, tips.invalid_subject, tips.name_taken, tips.goal_not_found or tips.self_dealing; 409 tips.not_accepting, tips.tts_disabled or tips.media_disabled; 409 tips.payment_failed (a replay of a request whose payment failed) and Billing's own refusal code (409 billing.insufficient_funds, else 422), both with the interaction in details; 404 tips.creator_not_found; 429 tips.too_many_pending; 502 tips.billing_unavailable. Unknown fields are ignored.

anyOf.description: A usr_ id or the creator's Tips handle.

amount.description: Vibes bits, at most TIPS_MAX_BITS (10000000 by default).

supporter.description: The supporter: required for services; ignored for a person.

supporter_name.description: The name to show (at most 80 characters kept); never the creator's own name or handle.

provider.description: pay_with checkout: one of TIPS_CHECKOUT_PROVIDERS (powerchat by default).

tts.description: Text-to-speech (kind tts): the text to read (default: message) and the voice.

url.description: An https link on an allowed host (TIPS_MEDIA_HOSTS; YouTube by default).

goal_id.description: One of the creator's open goals.

target.description: What the tip is for (a Live stream, …).

anonymous.description: The name reads "Anonymous" to everyone but the supporter.

hide_amount.description: The amount is left out of overlays, chat lines and public pages.

private_message.description: A tip's message is for the creator only (tips only; 422 for the other kinds).

privacy.description: The supporter's choices; any other field is refused (422 tips.invalid_input). true, 1, "1", "true" and "on" count as yes.
